question: What are the required documents and processing fees for online business locational clearance evaluated by CPDO?
answer:
For online business locational clearance evaluated by CPDO, the required documents are:

1. A written authority / permit granted by the City Planning and Development Office (CPDO) pursuant to applicable laws on land use planning and zoning for the establishment or operation of projects of national / local significance. [S3]
2. Seven (7) complete sets of Building Plans (original copy)
   a. Filled-up title blocks
   b. Signed and sealed by CE / Architect
   c. Certified True Copy of Title issued by the Registry of Deeds (ROD) or show original copy of title for validation (1 original for validation, 1 photocopy)
   d. Locational Clearance Application duly notarized and signed by the applicant (1 photocopy) [S1, S5]

The processing fee for online business locational clearance is PHP 1,500.00. [S4]

ground_truth: Under CPDO Service 12, Locational Clearance for Business (Online Application via appbts.davaocity.gov.ph) evaluates land-use compatibility under the Integrated ZO 2019-2028. Requirements uploaded to the portal are: 1) Filled-up application form; 2) Affidavit of Undertaking for neighbor's consent with sketch map; 3) Homeowners Association Certificate of No Objection (if inside a subdivision); 4) Proof of business working area pictures and road access; and 5) Certificate of Actual Land Occupancy (if inside ancestral land under RA 8371). There are no direct filing fees (None), and approval or issuance of a denial letter takes 1 Day and 50 Minutes.
